item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The band of clouds now covering the coast of Guangdong will thin out tomorrow. A dry northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. An intense replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong next Monday night. The weather will become cool appreciably and windy with one or two light rain patches over the region in the following couple of days. With the monsoon moderating slightly, temperatures will rise gradually over the region in the latter part of next week.
